mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES remains elevated or stops falling while TRANSIT is stable, commuting-related trips will keep feeding nearby retail visits and keep RETAIL_REC above the prior four-week average over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC averages lower over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days even though WORKPLACES does not drop by more than 5 points from t-0w and TRANSIT does not drop by more than 5 points from t-0w.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in RESIDENTIAL indicates more at-home time and less discretionary out-of-home shopping, so RETAIL_REC will drift downward within two weeks as shopping trips are substituted away.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall relative to the prior four-week mean within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL rises by at least 1 point from one weekly mean to the next.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in TRANSIT after a short recovery phase suppresses foot traffic to retail corridors and produces a lower RETAIL_REC mean over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls > 3 points week-on-week from a recent weekly mean
failure_condition: The next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not lower than the last 28-day mean after a week-on-week TRANSIT decline larger than 3 points.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM move up together, the same local activity wave spills into convenience retail trips, keeping RETAIL_REC firm over the following week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 7 days when both PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM are above their prior weekly means.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM rises while WORKPLACES stays weak, household errand consolidation substitutes for discretionary retail, pushing RETAIL_REC down over the next two to four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES remains at least 5 points below t-3w while GROCERY_PHARM is flat or rising
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES staying at least 5 points below t-3w and GROCERY_PHARM not falling.

mechanism_narrative: An upward PARKS trend signals weather-supported leisure mobility that diverts time and spending away from indoor retail, so RETAIL_REC will soften over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds the prior 28-day mean while PARKS is higher than its t-2w level.

mechanism_narrative: A recovery in TRANSIT after a trough only lifts retail when workplaces are also recovering; if both improve together, commuter-linked shopping rebounds within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises for two consecutive weekly means after a decline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays below its last-28-day mean over the next 28 days despite two consecutive weekly increases in TRANSIT and a concurrent rise in WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL is persistently positive and WORKPLACES remains depressed, the market is in a home-centered routine that delays shopping visits and lowers RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays above 5 and WORKPLACES stays below -30
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 7 days when RESIDENTIAL remains above 5 and WORKPLACES remains below -30.
